extraction_notes: PDF identity verified from the MMBTA05 title, NPN polarity, and Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd. footer; catalog manufacturer string preserved exactly as hongjiacheng.
Curve points are compact direct manual digitizations of the plotted traces. Values are converted from plotted mA, mV, pF, and uA labels to SI units without interpolation between points.
The datasheet gives table hFE values as guaranteed minimum or maximum bounds, VCE(sat) and VBE(sat) as guaranteed maximum bounds, and fT as a typical value; those source semantics are retained.

Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 have swapped caption and y-axis subject labels in the supplied PDF. The extraction follows the plotted y-axis labels and records the caption discrepancy in the test conditions and citations.
The schema has no dedicated scalar VBE(on) field; the available VBE(on) information is represented by the digitized Fig. 5 curves.
The schema has no fields for VCBO, VEBO, ICBO, ICEO, IEBO, collector-current maximum, power dissipation, or thermal resistance; these were not forced into unrelated fields.
